_comment: The complete product language set. Derived from Bulbul v3 (TTS), NOT from Saaras (STT). Saaras hears 22 Indian languages; Bulbul speaks 10. Do not extend without an ADR. See docs/adr/0005-tts-provider-split.md
_heard_not_speakable_comment: Saaras transcribes these accurately. Nothing in the stack can speak them. Enumerated explicitly so the gate can tell 'out of scope' apart from 'unrecognised' — those deserve different responses.
_refusal_ladder_comment: Language to SPEAK a refusal in when we have no better signal. Hindi has the widest comprehension across the excluded set; en-IN is the final fallback. Must only ever contain speakable codes.
_thresholds_comment: Tolerance rules from docs/06-speakability-gate.md section 6. Asymmetric on purpose: mis-transcribing Hinglish as Hindi is a small error; refusing a Hindi speaker is a large one.
